text: AI agent risk often starts with authority mismatch: the job is narrow, but the agent can read, decide or act far beyond it. Audit intent against capability before production.
Give every AI agent an authority ceiling: what it may read, recommend, execute, and when a human must step in. Audit that boundary before deployment.
“Completed” is not evidence. Production agents need verifiable proof: status, IDs, URLs, logs, or test results. Audit whether that proof actually exists.
